## NO CLASS but [Individual Meeting]{.green} with Instructor about Project Check-in

- You have to fill out [Form: Project and Team Check-in](https://forms.office.com/e/UZb7NFxLZB) by [**Two days before the class day**]{.red}. (See [Week #05](05-week.qmd) for details.)

- A [**meeting** will be scheduled on **MS Teams**]{.green} once you filled the form. It is supposed to lie in in class time 09:45 -- 12:30. Special arrangement are possible for online students, contact the instructor. 


## Assignments / Readings

- **Read Chapter 6 in {{< var dykes2019 >}}**, consult the [Reading  Remarks](../readings.qmd) for the Chapter. 
    - Enter your reading comments in the Form [My Comments: Chapter 6](https://forms.cloud.microsoft/e/uPQpu0FX7W) 

- [**Prepare your project pitch**]{.red} for Week #07:   
    - Prepare it in your project repository. See Week 5 how to make one. 
    - Have all essential parts outlined at [Milestone 1: Project Pitch](../milestones.qmd#m1) ready for the presentation. 
    - Perfection in visualization is not the goal at this stage, but having something to pitch.
